data.offering_description: Operates an online insurance marketplace where consumers compare auto, home, renters, life and health insurance quotes. Sells qualified consumer leads and policy referrals to insurance carriers and agencies, which pay per lead, click or sold policy.

data.primary_products: insurance leads; online insurance quote comparisons; policy referrals

data.primary_services: customer acquisition marketing; insurance shopping support

data.customer_segment: B2B: insurance carriers, insurance agencies and brokers that buy leads and referrals

data.revenue_model: transaction or usage fees: payments per lead, click or sold policy from insurance carriers and agencies

data.value_chain_position: software / platform: online marketplace that takes consumer shopping data and sells it to insurers and agencies; service provider: marketing and lead generation services sold to insurance carriers and agencies

data.geography_served: US national: consumers and insurers across the United States

data.specialization: related lines: auto, home, renters, life and health insurance lead lines that share consumers and technology

data.distribution_channels: online: consumer-facing websites and mobile apps where users compare quotes; direct sales: sales teams selling leads and referrals to insurance carriers and agencies

data.regulatory_exposure: medium: insurance lead sales under state insurance licensing rules, plus telemarketing and data privacy rules

data.offering_description: Operates an online insurance marketplace that connects consumers shopping for insurance with insurance carriers and agents. It generates quote requests and leads through its website, app and marketing, and sells them to carriers and agents, mainly for auto insurance.

data.primary_services: online insurance comparison marketplace; lead generation for insurers; customer referrals to insurance agents; data and analytics for carriers

data.customer_segment: B2B: insurance carriers and independent insurance agents buying leads and customer referrals; B2C: consumers comparing and shopping for auto, home, renters, life and health insurance

data.end_markets: insurance (auto, home and renters, life, health); consumer insurance shopping

data.revenue_model: transaction or usage fees: carriers pay per click, lead, call or referral, and for customer policy sales; commissions or management fees: commissions from carriers on policies sold through its agency channel

data.value_chain_position: software / platform: runs a digital marketplace taking in consumer quote requests and selling them to carriers and agents; financial intermediary: licensed agency selling policies for carriers

data.geography_served: US national: consumers and insurance carriers across the United States

data.specialization: related lines: auto, home and renters, life and health insurance marketplaces, mainly auto

data.distribution_channels: online: website and mobile app, with online marketing to attract consumers; direct sales: sales to insurance carriers and agent partners

data.regulatory_exposure: medium: insurance producer licensing and state insurance regulators, plus consumer privacy and telemarketing rules like TCPA

P1.2.text: EverQuote is the fast, free, and easy way to shop for insurance. Answer a few questions, compare top providers side by side, and connect for personalized auto and home quotes.

P1.3.text: The fast, free, and easy way to shop for insurance

P1.5.text: From first question to your matches

P1.6.text: Licensed carriers compared on every quote

P1.7.text: Average savings per year reported by EverQuote users

P1.9.text: Tell us a bit about yourself, get matched with top providers, and connect for personalized quotes.

P1.10.text: Answer a few simple questions about yourself and your insurance needs.

P1.11.text: We analyze a wide range of insurance providers to bring you the best matches tailored to your needs and preferences.

P1.12.text: Easily connect with insurance providers online or by phone to compare quotes and choose a plan that is right for you.

P1.13.text: One form. Every match, side by side.

P1.14.text: EverQuote matches you to insurers that best fit you, so you can see them all side by side.

P1.15.text: Same coverage levels on every quote, so it's a fair comparison.

P1.16.text: Quotes are always free, no matter who you get them from.

P1.17.text: Your details stay private until you decide to share them.

P1.18.text: Illustrative comparison, sample rates, not actual carrier quotes

P1.19.text: Our match engine ensures you get a policy that fits like a glove.

P1.21.text: Compare the best deals from top insurance providers and independent agents to get the best coverage for the best price.

P1.22.text: It couldnât be easier to bundle your home and auto insurance and save on both.

P1.23.text: Combine insurance for the entire household into one simple policy with great savings.

P1.24.text: We know that finding the right insurance can be challenging. There are many coverage options, complex pricing and dozens of insurance companies to choose from. EverQuote works to save you time and money by providing a single starting point for insurance shopping.

P1.25.text: We can help you find auto and home insurance.

P1.26.text: After you fill out a simple online form, our technology matches you to relevant options.

P1.27.text: You may receive quotes via phone or email from local insurance agents in your area who represent some of the best insurance companies nationwide. You can decide how you want agents to contact you. Our technology uses the information you provide to match you to insurers that can meet your needs.

P1.28.text: The agents can answer any questions you have about coverage, and assist you in finding an insurance policy that has the coverage you want and that can save you money. Additionally, many insurance companies now provide online quoting for users who prefer self-service.

P1.29.text: EverQuote service is free to consumers.

P1.30.text: Filling out the form is quick and easy. It takes less than two minutes. You will begin receiving quotes from local agents usually within minutes of your request. Additionally, getting online quotes from insurers takes only a small additional investment of time for each one. These insurers typically provide a quote at the end of their online forms.

P1.31.text: Contact from insurers and local agents typically begins within minutes of your submission. Filling out additional requests for online quotes from insurers typically produces a result within minutes for each form, or provides further contact information to proceed via phone or email.

P1.32.text: The information you provide will be shared with insurance agents and insurance companies that intend to assist you with insurance quotes and coverage information. We will not sell or redistribute your information to any other third party other than in compliance with our Privacy Policy.

P1.33.text: EverQuote's headquarters are in Cambridge, Massachusetts.

data.offering_description: Operates an online automotive marketplace where car dealers list new and used vehicles and buy advertising and software tools to attract shoppers. It sells mainly to franchised and independent auto dealers and to car manufacturers, delivering the service through subscriptions, digital advertising and dealer software.

data.primary_products: vehicle listings; dealer websites; digital retailing software

data.primary_services: digital advertising; lead generation; dealer marketing services

data.customer_segment: B2B: franchised and independent car dealers, automotive manufacturers and their advertising programs

data.end_markets: automotive retail; automotive manufacturing; digital advertising

data.revenue_model: subscription: dealers pay recurring fees for listings and software; advertising: manufacturers and dealers pay for promotional placements on the marketplace

data.value_chain_position: software / platform: runs an online marketplace and dealer software, sold to car dealers; service provider: provides marketing and lead generation services to dealers and manufacturers

data.geography_served: US national: serves dealers and shoppers across the United States

data.specialization: related lines: vehicle listings, dealer software and automotive advertising, sharing dealer and shopper customers
